search:0:ਸਦਕਸਘਕ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥

search:0:ਸਦਕਸਘਕ.translation: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?

search:1:ਕਜਬਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
search:1:ਕਜਬਸਸ.transliteration: so dar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale |
search:1:ਕਜਬਸਸ.translation: What is that Gate, and what is that Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

search:1:ਕਜਬਸਸ.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਜਾਈਐ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:1:ਕਜਬਸਸ.transliteration: tis gur kai jaaeeai balihaaree sadaa sadaa hau vaariaa |1| rahaau |
search:1:ਕਜਬਸਸ.translation: I am a sacrifice to that Guru; I am devoted to Him, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

search:1:ਘਹਪਨਪਅਮਅ.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
search:1:ਘਹਪਨਪਅਮਅ.transliteration: ghar hodaa purakh na pachhaaniaa abhimaan mutthe ahankaar |
search:1:ਘਹਪਨਪਅਮਅ.translation: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.

search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸ.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸ.transliteration: jinee purakhee satagur na sevio se dukhee jug chaar |
search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸ.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.

search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸ.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਪੰਚ ਸੁ ਨਾਮਯ ਸੰਖ ਸੁਭੰ ॥
search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸ.transliteration: jan panch su naamay sankh subhan |
search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸ.translation: These minor jewels are leech, myrobalan, honey, conch ( panchjanay), ruta, hemp, discus and mace

search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸ.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪਿਰੀਆ ਸਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਸੇ ਸਜਣ ਮੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸ.transliteration: jin pireea sau nehu se sajan mai naal |
search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸ.translation: That Beloved, with whom I am in love, that Friend of mine is with me.

search:1:ਜਪਸਨਸਸਦਜਚ.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥

search:1:ਧਧਰਗਲਸਪ.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
search:1:ਧਧਰਗਲਸਪ.transliteration: dhandhaa dhaavat reh ge laagaa saach piaar |
search:1:ਧਧਰਗਲਸਪ.translation: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.

search:1:ਮਅਸਗਪ.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
search:1:ਮਅਸਗਪ.transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
search:1:ਮਅਸਗਪ.translation: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~

One who is dead while yet alive,
People say it is good to live forever,

search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.transliteration: hohu deaal kripaa kar har jeeo har siau rahaan samaaee |2|
search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.translation: O Dear Lord, please be kind and compassionate to me, that I might remain merged in You, O Lord. ||2||

search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਊਹਾਂ ਚਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.transliteration: anik baar kar bandan santan aoohaan charan gobind jee ke basanaa |1| rahaau |
search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.translation: Humbly bow to the Saints, over and over again; through them, the Feet of the Lord of the Universe shall come to abide within you. ||1||Pause||

search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਹ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਹਿਾਂਗੇ ॥
search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.transliteration: mo keh jeevat mukat sadaa siv karahiaange |

search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਾਂ ਪਿਆਰਿਆਂ ਚੌਹਾਂ ਸਾਹਿਬਜ਼ਾਦਿਆਂ ਚਾਲ੍ਹੀਆਂ ਮੁਕਤਿਆਂ ਹਠੀਆਂ ਜਪੀਆਂ ਤਪੀਆਂ ਜਿਹਨਾਂ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿਆ ਵੰਡ ਛਕਿਆ ਦੇਗ ਚਲਾਈ ਤੇਗ ਵਾਹੀ ਦੇਖ ਕੇ ਅਣਡਿੱਤ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਪਿਆਰਿਆਂ ਸਚਿਆਰਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਕਮਾਈ ਦਾ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰ ਕੇ ਖ਼ਾਲਸਾ ਜੀ ਬੋਲੋ ਜੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ।
search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.transliteration: panjaan piaariaan chauahaan saahibazaadiaan chaalheean mukatiaan hattheean japeean tapeean jihanaan naam japiaa vandd chhakiaa deg chalaaee teg vaahee dekh ke anaddat keetaa tinhaan piaariaan sachiaariaan dee kamaaee daa dhiaan dhar ke khaalasaa jee bolo jee vaahiguroo |
search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.translation: Meditating on the achievement of the dear and truthful ones, including the five beloved ones, the four sons of the tenth Guru, forty liberated ones, steadfast ones, constant repeaters of the Divine Name, those given to assiduous devotion, those who repeated the Naam, shared their fare with others, ran free kitchen, wielded the sword and ever looked faults and shortcomings, say "Waheguru", O Khalsa.

search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾਂ ਜਹਾਂ ਖ਼ਾਲਸਾ ਜੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤਹਾਂ ਤਹਾਂ ਰਛਿਆਂ ਰਿਆਇਤ ਦੇਗ ਤੇਗ ਫ਼ਤਹ ਬਿਰਦ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ ਜੀਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ ਸਹਾਇ ਖ਼ਾਲਸੇ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਬੋਲ ਬਾਲੇ ਬੋਲੋ ਜੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ।
search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.transliteration: jahaan jahaan khaalasaa jee saahib tahaan tahaan rachhiaan riaaeit deg teg fateh birad kee paij panth kee jeet sree saahib jee sahaae khaalase jee ke bol baale bolo jee vaahiguroo |
search:4:ਹਾਂ ਜੀ.translation: Wherever there are communities of the Khalsa, may there be Divine protection and grace, and ascendance of the supply of needs and of the holy sword, protection of the tradition of grace, victory to the Panth, the succor of the holy sword, and ascendance of the Khalsa. Say, O Khalsa, "Waheguru".

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: jinee purakhee satagur na sevio se dukhee jug chaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: ghar hodaa purakh na pachhaaniaa abhimaan mutthe ahankaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਫਿਟਕਿਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: sataguroo kiaa fittakiaa mang thake sansaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: sachaa sabad na sevio sabh kaaj savaaranahaar |1|
shabad:BQ8.translation: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of their problems. ||1||

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: man mere sadaa har vekh hadoor |
shabad:BQ8.translation: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: janam maran dukh paraharai sabad rahiaa bharapoor |1| rahaau |
shabad:BQ8.translation: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill you to overflowing. ||1||Pause||

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: sach salaahan se sache sachaa naam adhaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: sachee kaar kamaavanee sache naal piaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: sachaa saahu varatadaa koe na mettanahaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: manamukh mehal na paaeinee koorr mutthe koorriaar |2|
shabad:BQ8.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The false are plundered by falsehood. ||2||

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: haumai karataa jag muaa gur bin ghor andhaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: maaeaa mohi visaariaa sukhadaataa daataar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: satagur seveh taa ubareh sach rakheh ur dhaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in their hearts.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: kirapaa te har paaeeai sach sabad veechaar |3|
shabad:BQ8.translation: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: satagur sev man niramalaa haumai taj vikaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism and corruption are discarded.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: aap chhodd jeevat marai gur kai sabad veechaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: dhandhaa dhaavat reh ge laagaa saach piaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: sach rate mukh ujale tith saachai darabaar |4|
shabad:BQ8.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: satagur purakh na manio sabad na lago piaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: eisanaan daan jetaa kareh doojai bhaae khuaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: har jeeo aapanee kripaa kare taa laagai naam piaar |
shabad:BQ8.translation: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.

shabad:BQ8.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੨੦॥੫੩॥
shabad:BQ8.transliteration: naanak naam samaal too gur kai het apaar |5|20|53|
shabad:BQ8.translation: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||5||20||53||
